stories.headline: Four astronauts launch towards the space station
stories.summary: Four astronauts are on their way to the International Space Station. SpaceX's Crew-13 mission launched on 1 October from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida, carrying two NASA astronauts, a Canadian Space Agency astronaut and a Roscosmos cosmonaut. The flight had been due in September, but a leak in an oxidizer tank held it back.

stories.headline: A court clears the way for the Warner Bros. Discovery sale
stories.summary: Paramount Skydance is now free to complete its purchase of Warner Bros. Discovery. A court approved the company's settlement with California and 11 other American states on 30 September, and Paramount says it expects to finish the acquisition by 6 October. It agreed in February to pay $31 per share for the business.

stories.headline: San Marino swears in a new pair of Captains Regent
stories.summary: San Marino swore in a new pair of Captains Regent on 1 October. Gerardo Giovagnoli and William Casali took over from Alice Mina and Vladimiro Selva as the republic's joint heads of state. Each pair serves a six-month term, and the investiture always falls on 1 April and 1 October.

stories.headline: Two new stick insects found in Australia
stories.summary: Australia has two new stick insects. A team at the University of Sydney re-examined the genus Anchiale and found two species that had never been described, one of them laying eggs with a lid-like structure. What had been counted as two species turns out to be five.

sources.excerpt: The mission launched October 1, 2026 at 11:10:06 am to transport four crew members—NASA astronauts Jessica Watkins and Luke Delaney, CSA astronaut Joshua Kutryk, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov—to the International Space Station (ISS).
Kutryk is the first Canadian to be sent to orbit as part of the Commercial Crew Program.
The 13th operational SpaceX mission under NASA's Commercial Crew Program was scheduled to launch on September 12, 2026, but a leak in Grace's oxidizer tank delayed the launch.

The SpaceX Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station launches, carrying two NASA astronauts, one Roscosmos cosmonaut, and one Canadian Space Agency astronaut, from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida, United States.

On February 27, 2026, Paramount Skydance announced its intent to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD). As part of their definitive agreement, the company was to acquire WBD for $31 per share, valuing the company at $110.9 billion.
In July 2026, California and 11 other U.S. states, as well as the Writers Guild of America, filed antitrust lawsuits in a California federal court to delay the consummation of the purchase.
The settlement was approved by the court on September 30, 2026; Paramount stated that it expects to complete the acquisition by October 6, 2026.
The Captains Regent are the heads of state, a function which they carry out as a single body, with a reciprocal right of veto.
Normally the Captains Regent are chosen from parties in coalition and serve a six-month term.
The investiture of the Captains Regent takes place on 1 April and 1 October every year. This tradition dates back at least to 1243.
